text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like <chrname> has 
sustained a minor injury...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, this is the precious Shuntaisai 
Training Camp. 
Now then, what should we do---
choice_data_list: Push her to do her best

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to have her focus thoroughly on 
recovery.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to move her body, 
<chrname> seems a bit downcast...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave <chrname> passionate encouragement 
and urged her to keep pushing through---

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, it ended in failure! 
Her injury seems to have worsened...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, miraculously, her injury was 
completely healed, 
and the practice went splendidly!!
